column1: # The reading of the resource heartbeat platform/resources/<server>/heartbeat by the form and the outcomes of the family (the observation contract «Form»;

column4: note
a heartbeat in form — read, no fields with a field outcome
valid retention_garbled and retention_withheld — read (C04-DEP-OBS-HEARTBEAT-01)
retention_withheld: unknown — a word of the list
a wrong word in retention_withheld — the heartbeat is read, the field reads as absent (outcome /retention_withheld)
retention_withheld not a mapping — the field is absent, the heartbeat is read
retention_garbled not a list — the field is absent, the heartbeat is read
an empty list — out of form (min_items 1, no reason — no field): the field is absent
build not a string — outcome /build: reads as "", the heartbeat is read
two fields with a field outcome — both, the heartbeat is read
no server — the whole object is unreadable (the outcome «the whole object»)
a field outside the form — the whole object is unreadable (the form is closed)
space out of form — the whole object is unreadable (space has no field outcome)
an exponent in the time lexeme ts (1e0) — the time is out of form (codec.tsv time, the reader: only ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]{1,3})?$) — the whole object is unreadable
usage_at 1e-400 — an exponent: out of form, though in binary64 it is 0 — the whole object is unreadable
ts -0 — a sign: the time is out of form — the whole object is unreadable
usage 100.0 — an integer by the exact decimal value of the lexeme (100) — read
usage 100.00000000000000001 — the exact decimal value is not an integer (in binary64 it would be 100) — the whole object is unreadable (usage has no field outcome)
schema 1.0 — whole: only an integer sign — the field outcome of schema (the schema is unknown), the heartbeat is read
Z10 current Time precision; same whole-heartbeat unreadable outcome as existing time-exponent; no truncation.
